meta.name: understand-domain
meta.description: Extract business domain knowledge from a codebase and generate an interactive domain flow graph. Works standalone (lightweight scan) or derives from an existing /understand knowledge graph.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从代码库提取业务领域知识并生成交互式流程图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从现有代码中梳理业务逻辑和领域模型
copy.tagline_en: Extract business domain knowledge from codebase and generate interactive flow graph
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract business logic and domain models from existing code

howto.what: 这项技能让 Claude 能从当前项目的代码库（或已有的知识图谱）中提取业务领域、业务流程与步骤，生成可交互的横向流程图，并在仪表盘中展示。
howto.when: 当用户要求分析项目的业务领域、梳理业务流程，或直接调用 /understand-domain 时触发；如果已有知识图谱就直接用它生成，没有则做轻量扫描，加 --full 可强制重新扫描。

say.text: 用 understand-domain 看一下这个项目的业务领域。
say.note: 会扫描代码并生成领域流程图。

say.text: 运行 /understand-domain --full 重新扫描一遍。
say.note: 即使已有知识图谱，也会强制重扫。

say.text: 基于已有的知识图谱生成领域流程图。
say.note: 不从代码扫描，直接从现有图谱派生。

howto.what_en: This skill lets Claude extract business domains, flows and steps from a codebase (or from an existing knowledge graph), produce an interactive horizontal flow diagram, and show it in the dashboard.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to analyze business domains/flows or runs /understand-domain. If a knowledge graph exists it is reused; otherwise a lightweight scan runs. --full forces rescan.

say_en.text: Use understand-domain to look at this project's business domains.
say_en.note: It scans the code and makes a domain flow graph.
Forces a full rescan even if a graph exists.

say_en.text: Generate a domain flow graph from the existing knowledge graph.
say_en.note: It derives the graph without scanning files.
